items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Coo Coo played in Tuxing and Bound, you too.

ctx.x: Yeah, the D. is the D. is my brass band. Is that right? Yeah. He had the D. said he was blind in the hall. He was blind in the hall. He was blind. Well, I got a loan so blind, and I told him, he'll have to let him take the frequency. He wouldn't. Mm-hmm.

I didn't play in the hall now. I think he could if he... He could? He could play, I think, if he'd get straight. You know, but he and the other are so... Yeah. Just let themselves go. They're both sick. Out of the union, isn't it? Yeah. What about Coo Coo? Coo Coo died. Yeah. Did you play with him that one? Coo Coo played in Tuxing and Bound, you too. Mm-hmm. What would he play first or second? The island of the league. He'd play the league. He would have good old trumpet. Mm-hmm. Tawa. Yeah, Coo Coo would have…
